QuestInfo.name: To Catch a Phantom
QuestInfo.0: With a new ally made in #p2420012#, the duo was close to getting what they wanted. But will this girl really know where #p2420015# is hiding?
QuestInfo.1: As a sign of good faith, #p2420012# told Alpha and Beta where to find #p2420015#'s hideout. The cunning thief had hidden his base under a rock in #m322000000# #MDmap322090110#. They would need to leave town to reach #b#MDmap322090110##k, and utter the special password: #bOpen Sesame#k.
QuestInfo.2: When the duo arrived, they found no Phantom below the rock... only #o9300760#, and #p2420007#! He told them a trio of sisters named the Sisters of Gold trapped him there. Maybe #p2420012#, #p2420013#, and #p2420014# weren't being so honest after all.

npc.0: I just have to tell you where Phantom's hideout is, right? That's easy! He's got a hideout under a rock. You just need the password to get in!
npc.1: The password is #bOpen Sesame#k. Don't forget! And just capture Phantom.
